title: Apyx Medical Corporation Announces Retrospective Clinical Publication Evaluating Clinical Benefit of Renuvion® Used in Combination with Liposuction
summary: Analysis showed that liposuction followed by helium plasma RF was associated with higher patient-reported satisfaction with abdominal appearance, lower abdominoplasty and revision rates, and comparable complication rates versus conventional liposuction alone.
